fields.value: 90 business days before expiry of the then current period

quotes.text:
A party wishing to prevent such renewal must serve written notice on
the other party not less than ninety (90) business days before the
expiry of the then current period.

ambiguities: Clause 3 RENEWAL uses business days but the Agreement contains no definition of business days or holiday calendar for calculating the deadline.

fields.value: Buyer may terminate for convenience on not less than 60 days' written notice to Supplier.

quotes.text:
The Buyer may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving not
less than sixty (60) days written notice to the Supplier.

fields.value: Either party may terminate by written notice for the other party's material breach if not remedied within 30 days after written notice requiring remedy.

quotes.text:
Either party may terminate this Agreement by written notice where the
other is in material breach of it and has not remedied that breach
within thirty (30) days of written notice requiring it to do so.

fields.value: Supplier's total liability to Buyer is capped at S$75,000, except liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence or for fraud.

quotes.text:
The total liability of the Supplier to the Buyer under this Agreement,
whether in contract, tort or otherwise, shall not in any event exceed
S$$75,000.

Nothing in this clause limits liability for death or personal injury
caused by negligence or for fraud.

payments.description: Buyer must pay Supplier a quarterly service charge in arrears on the last day of each calendar quarter.

quotes.text:
This Agreement takes effect on 7 July 2026 and continues for a period
of thirty-six (36) months from that date.

The Buyer shall pay to the Supplier a quarterly service charge of
S$$22,500, payable in arrears on the last day of each calendar quarter.

payments.description: Buyer must pay other invoiced amounts for goods supplied within 30 days from the invoice date.
payments.conditionNote: Due date and amount depend on Supplier invoices for goods supplied; invoice dates and amounts are not fixed in the Agreement.

quotes.text:
All other amounts invoiced by the Supplier for goods supplied shall be
paid within thirty (30) days from the date of invoice.
